names.note: Read out of the Sretensky life’s heading «Святая великомученица Евфимия Всехвальная, мученики Виктор и Сосфен».
Read out of «Св. вел. муч. Ефимија.» in this folder’s Serbian citation.

death.note: saint.gr: lived and was martyred in the years of Diocletian.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 сентября ст. ст. — «Вмц. Евфимии всехвальной (304)»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 29.09.2026 (16. септембар ст. ст.) — „Св. вел. муч. Ефимија.“

hymns.text: Τῷ θείῳ ἔρωτι, Λαμπρῶς ἀθλήσασα, εἰς oσμὴν ἔδραμες, Χριστοῦ πανεύφημε, οἴα νεᾶνις παγκαλῆς, καὶ Μάρτυς πεποικιλμένη, ὅθεν εἰσελήλυθας, ἐiς παστάδα οὐράνιον, κόσμω διανέμουσα, ἰαμάτων χαρίσματα, καὶ σῴζουσα τοὺς σοὶ ἐκβοώντας, χαίροις θεόφρον Εὐφημία.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Αγία Ευφημία, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: Having contended splendidly with divine love, thou didst run after the fragrance of Christ, O all-praised one, as a maiden altogether fair and a martyr adorned; wherefore thou hast entered into the heavenly bridal chamber, distributing to the world the gifts of healings and saving those who cry unto thee: Rejoice, O Euphemia of godly mind.

hymns.text: Ἐν τῇ ἀθλήσει σου καλῶς ἠγωνίσω, καὶ μετὰ θάνατον ἡμᾶς ἁγιάζεις, ταῖς τῶν θαυμάτων βλύσεσι Πανεύφημε, ὅθεν σου τὴν κοίμησιν, τὴν ἁγίαν τιμῶμεν, πίστει παριστάμενοι, τῷ σεπτῷ σου λειψάνῳ, ἵνα ῥυσθῶμεν νόσων ψυχικῶν, καὶ τῶν θαυμάτων τὴν χάριν ἀντλήσωμεν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Αγία Ευφημία, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: In thy contest thou didst strive nobly, and after death thou dost sanctify us with the streams of thy wonders, O all-praised one. Therefore we honour thy holy falling asleep with faith, standing before thy precious relics, that we may be delivered from the sicknesses of the soul and may draw the grace of wonders.

hymns.text: Întru chinuirea ta bine te-ai nevoit şi după moarte pe noi ne sfinţeşte cu izvoarele minunilor, prealăudată. Pentru aceasta, cinstim cu credinţă sfântă adormirea ta, stând înaintea cinstitelor tale moaşte, ca să ne mântuim de neputinţe sufleteşti şi să luăm dar din minune.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfintei Mari Muceniţe Eufimia

english.text: In thy contest thou didst strive nobly, and after death thou dost sanctify us with the streams of thy wonders, O all-praised one. Therefore we honour thy holy falling asleep with faith, standing before thy precious relics, that we may be delivered from the sicknesses of the soul and may draw the grace of wonders.

hymns.text: Nevoinţe în chinuri, nevoinţe pentru credinţă cu avânt ai suferit pentru Hristos, Mirele tău. Acestuia şi acum roagă-te, să se surpe trufia vrăjmaşilor sub picioarele binecredincioşilor, ca şi atunci eresurile prin rugăciunile Născătoarei de Dumnezeu, ceea ce ai primit hotărârea credinţei, de la cei şase sute şi treizeci de Dumnezeu purtători Părinţi şi o păstrezi, prealăudată.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfintei Mari Muceniţe Eufimia

english.text: Struggles in torments, struggles for the faith didst thou suffer with eagerness for Christ thy Bridegroom. Unto him pray thou now also, that the pride of the enemies may be cast down beneath the feet of the right-believing, as of old were the heresies, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O thou who didst receive the definition of the faith from the six hundred and thirty God-bearing Fathers and dost keep it, O all-praised one.

hymns.text: Lupte în chinuri, lupte în credinţă ai purtat cu căldură pentru Hristos, Mirele tău. Şi aşa precum ai zdrobit eresurile, aşa şi acum întărâtările vrăjmaşilor supune-le sub picioarele poporului nostru, rugând pe Născătoarea de Dumnezeu. Căci tu ai luat de la cei şase sute şi treizeci purtători de Dumnezeu părinţi hotarul credinţei şi l-ai păzit pe el, ceea ce eşti prealăudată.

english.text: Thou didst bear with fervour the struggles of suffering and the struggles of the faith for Christ thy Bridegroom. And as thou didst once crush the heresies, so now also put the assaults of our enemies under the feet of our people, entreating the Theotokos; for from the six hundred and thirty God-bearing fathers thou didst receive the definition of the faith, and thou hast kept it, O all-praised one.

hymns.text: Агница Твоя, Иисусе, Евфимия/ зовет велиим гласом:/ Тебе, Женише мой, люблю,/ и Тебе ищущи страдальчествую,/ и сраспинаюся, и спогребаюся Крещению Твоему,/ и стражду Тебе ради,/ яко да царствую в Тебе,/ и умираю за Тя, да и живу с Тобою;/ но яко жертву непорочную приими мя,/ с любовию пожершуюся Тебе.// Тоя молитвами, яко Милостив, спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 сентября ст. ст. — «Тропарь великомученицы Евфимии»

english.text: Thy ewe-lamb, O Jesus, Euphemia, crieth with a loud voice: Thee, my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking thee I suffer; I am crucified and buried with thee in thy baptism, and I suffer for thy sake, that I may reign in thee; I die for thee, that I may also live with thee. But as a spotless sacrifice accept me, who am offered to thee with love. Through her prayers, since thou art merciful, save our souls.

hymns.text: Жениха твоего Христа возлюбивши/ и свещу твою светлу уготовльши,/ добродетельми возсиявши, всехвальная Евфимие,/ тем возшла еси с Ним на брак,/ венец страдания от Него приемши./ Но от бед избави нас,/ чтущих верою память твою.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 сентября ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь великомученицы Евфимии всехвальной»

english.text: Having loved Christ thy Bridegroom and made ready thy bright lamp, shining with the virtues, O all-praised Euphemia, thou didst go in with him to the marriage, receiving from him the crown of suffering. But deliver from misfortunes us who honour thy memory with faith.

hymns.text: Во страдальчестве твоем добре подвизалася еси/ и по смерти ны освящаеши чудес точеньми, всехвальная./ Темже твое успение святое поем,/ верою притекающе/ в божественный храм твой,/ да избавимся недугов душевных// и чудес благодать почерпем.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 сентября ст. ст. — «Кондак великомученицы Евфимии»

english.text: In thy suffering thou didst contend nobly, and after death thou dost sanctify us with streams of wonders, O all-praised one. Therefore we sing of thy holy falling asleep, hastening with faith to thy divine temple, that we may be delivered from the ailments of the soul and may draw the grace of wonders.
